news.title: Third quarter 2026 earnings released: EPS: ₹0.50 (vs ₹1.04 in 3Q 2025)
news.body: Third quarter 2026 results: EPS: ₹0.50 (down from ₹1.04 in 3Q 2025). Revenue: ₹182.6m (down 56% from 3Q 2025). Net income: ₹7.08m (down 52% from 3Q 2025). Profit margin: 3.9% (up from 3.5% in 3Q 2025). The increase in margin was driven by lower expenses. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has increased by 17% per year but the company’s share price has increased by 108% per year, which means it is tracking significantly ahead of earnings growth.

news.title: New major risk - Share price stability
news.body: The company's share price has been highly volatile over the past 3 months. It is more volatile than 90% of Indian stocks, typically moving 8.5% a week. This is considered a major risk. Share price volatility increases the risk of potential losses in the short-term as the stock tends to have larger drops in price more frequently than other stocks. It may also indicate the stock is highly sensitive to market conditions or economic conditions rather than being sensitive to its own business performance, which may also be inconsistent. news.title: Dhanashree Electronics Limited Announces Resignation of Rishav Sethia Independent Director and Member of Nomination and Remuneration Committees, Effective November 30, 2025
news.body: Dhanashree Electronics Limited announced that Mr. Rishav Sethia has resigned from the post of Independent Director of the company with effect November 30, 2025 due to personal reasons. Accordingly, Mr. Rishav Sethia shall also cease to be the Member of Nomination and Remuneration Committees of the company wherein he was a member.
